title: Goal-Oriented Error Estimation for Least-Squares Finite Element Methods via Physically Meaningful Adjoint PDEs
summary: We develop a goal-oriented error-estimation framework for first-order system least-squares (FOSLS) finite element methods based on the physical PDE adjoint rather than the adjoint induced by the least-squares formulation. Identified explicitly from the differential operator, its mixed boundary conditions, and the output, the physical adjoint admits its own first-order flux system and hence a native, built-in least-squares estimator, which the least-squares-induced adjoint does not.
